entities.name: Porphobilinogen deaminase
observations: The 308-aa query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry C1D679 from Laribacter hongkongensis.
Curated function: polymerizes four porphobilinogen molecules into hydroxymethylbilane in several discrete steps.
EC number: 2.5.1.61; GO molecular function: hydroxymethylbilane synthase activity.
The enzyme binds one dipyrromethane group covalently as cofactor.

entities.name: Porphobilinogen to hydroxymethylbilane
observations: Rhea RHEA:13185 records the reaction: 4 porphobilinogen + H2O = hydroxymethylbilane + 4 NH4(+).
This is the second step of heme/porphyrin biosynthesis after 5-aminolevulinate formation of porphobilinogen.

entities.name: Dipyrromethane cofactor
observations: Porphobilinogen deaminase covalently binds one dipyrromethane prosthetic group, ChEBI:CHEBI:60342.
